corrections.public_notice: Earlier releases could return legal when required Opportunity Attack, Help, or Grapple/Shove facts were omitted, and reaction.available did not apply conditions that include Incapacitated. Version 0.6.0 refuses missing prerequisite facts and applies the cited condition embeds.
corrections.caller_action: Audit prior positive results from these four query types when prerequisite facts were omitted or the actor had Stunned, Paralyzed, Petrified, or Unconscious. Re-run them with the corrected adapter and supply the facts named by a refusal.
corrections.migration_note: OA callers supply movement_kind and, on a potentially provoking voluntary path, leaves_reach and mover_seen_by_reactor. Help callers supply the kind-specific proficiency or five-foot fact. Grapple/Shove callers supply both sizes, and Grapple callers also supply has_free_hand. DC formula blanks remain optional. An authorized agent-DM supplies observed table facts or exercises and records table authority; it need not escalate to a separate human DM.

corrections.public_notice: Earlier event.apply implementations accepted incomplete or malformed state and sometimes defaulted conditional event facts, crashed, or emitted a transition whose meaning was not justified by supplied facts. The corrected 0.6.0 release validates canonical state and refuses with exact recovery paths before mutation or lineage stamping.
corrections.caller_action: Audit prior event.apply transitions created from partial state or omitted event facts. Re-run them with canonical state and supply the exact facts named by any refusal. Before resuming a chain persisted by an earlier release, remove its legacy lineage and explicitly re-anchor the audited canonical state; legacy hashes did not commit their lineage metadata and therefore fail closed in 0.6.0. When the rules genuinely leave a choice to the DM, an authorized agent-DM may apply a ruling event with a nonblank note and a schema- and adapter-model-valid state patch. Keep unmodeled or homebrew state in the caller's ledger or select a matching adapter.
corrections.migration_note: event.apply callers now send speed, conditions, and the complete six-field turn budget in state. Damage, healing, movement, condition, death-save, and ruling events supply the facts required by their selected branch. A lineage self hash now commits the canonical state plus seq, prev, event, rule_ids, and kind; pre-0.6.0 stamped states must be audited, stripped of legacy lineage, and re-anchored because accepting their payload-only hashes would also accept metadata tampering. Structurally invalid state returns invalid-input; absent conditional facts return missing-fact with exact state.* or event.* paths; refusals never return next_state or stamp lineage. This deliberate correction supersedes the old partial-state event.apply case in the v0.5 semantic fixture.
